leftEvidence.title: Living waters flow from Jerusalem as the LORD becomes king

points.label: Water movement
points.left: Living waters flow east and west in summer and winter.
points.right: A bright river flows from the throne through the city.

points.label: City and reign
points.left: Jerusalem dwells securely as the LORD is king over all the earth.
points.right: God’s servants see his face and reign forever.

points.label: Tree wording
points.left: No tree is named beside the living waters.
points.right: The tree of life bears fruit and healing leaves beside the river.

payload.posture: Hold both Scripture sources together while preserving their participants, setting, sequence, genre, and inference boundaries.

rightEvidence.title: The river of life flows from the throne beside the tree

payload.tension: Both visions join life-giving water, city, and reign, while only Revelation places the tree of life beside the river.
payload.title: Living waters from the reigning city
